title: Korean-Style German Sausage Jjigae
description: A hearty German-inspired Korean stew made with sausage and Korean chili flakes.

ingredients.name: Soy sauce (make sure it's whole30 compliant)

instructions: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausage from the pan and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pan and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the Korean chili flakes and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked rigatoni, soy sauce, and broth to the pan.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Return the sausage to the pan and simmer for an additional 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions if desired.
